mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% (the 25th percentile of historical values).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1400) and GDP (GDPC1 > 24000) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST > 1400 and GDPC1 > 24000.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the tight labor market supports strong wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weak labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0% (the 75th percentile of historical values).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 thousand units signals weak residential construction, a key component of consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO > 105 and CPIAUCSL > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by strong industrial activity and high consumer spending), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as the market anticipates continued economic momentum, with the effect most pronounced over a 20-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO > 105 and RSAFS > 750000.
